# Usage: chart.sh <command> <data> [options]
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

show_help() {
    cat <<'EOF'
chart.sh — 数据可视化图表生成器

Usage:

  chart.sh pie "A:30,B:50,C:20" [--title "分布"]           ASCII饼图
